title: OK Go - This Too Shall Pass - Rube Goldberg Machine - Official Video
summary: OK Go's music video for This Too Shall Pass, featuring a huge Rube Goldberg machine built in a warehouse in Los Angeles with Syyn Labs. The band interacts with the contraption in one continuous take.
why: HN points to it as an example of ambitious, practical-effects creativity in music videos, made without CGI.

quote.text: The Rube Goldberg machine [0] one is particularily impressive.
